thread.title: Apple: Conservative Price Target Of $240 (Mark Hibben) - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)

author: Brian Bain
title: Apple: Conservative Price Target Of $240 (Mark Hibben) - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
The story behind the interview: Mark has long been one of my favorite sources for understanding and following Apple ( AAPL ).
With the positive investor reaction to Apple's latest earnings report, I wanted to follow-up with Mark to find out what's going on and why investors should care.
For those who prefer to read, my full interview notes are copied below.
Link to Mark's original article: Apple: Still A Bargain
Interview Notes: Response to earnings report earlier in the month
Apple did better than many fear mongering people thought
iPhone X was a strong seller
Strong earnings report
Mark is pretty convinced he has been undervaluing Apple
He needed to overhaul his investment case report for Apple as to why it is a good investment
Mark doesn’t claim perfect objectivity
He focused on the DCF model he maintains for companies in his portfolio
He sees iPhone X as a big positive
Based on his expectations for future iPhone sales he has revised future revenue projections
No longer expects a decline in iPhone in the next 5 years
Other factors of note:
Wearables
Services
30% y o y growth in services
37% y o y growth in other products (ex: wearables)
The addition of LTE capability for Watch has been significant, now largely independent of iPhone
Other wearable competitors have been lagging
Reports of lack of support for Android ( GOOG ) (NASDAQ: GOOGL ) wearables
Problem with Qualcomm ( QCOM ) chips that have not been updated for years
Fitbit ( FIT ) has struggled as well
Because Apple designs and customizes its own processors it can optimize processors much better and keep moving forward with great products
“New Paradigm” for chips
Hardware, software, and chips all created and optimized to work together
Nvidia ( NVDA ) has been a leader in this shift
Intel ( INTC ) has lagged and Qualcomm is on the border
Themes that have set up Nvidia to see great success are also setting Apple apart
iPhone X
Press coverage was overtly negative leading up earnings
Reverse was true
iPhone X has been the best seller of current iPhone lineup
Unit volume was down y o y for iPhone (modestly)
Is Apple still a bargain?
DCF model results
His revised revenue profile led to a DCF fair value of $240
This valuation does not include revenue contribution from Apple smart glasses
Very conservative valuation
Apple has a strong focus on augmented reality
Next Steps... I hope you enjoyed this interview.
